user_prompt: We need to pull together a comprehensive view of our production risks and costs right now - I want to see both our material expenses broken down by supplier along with any compliance gaps, and at the same time analyze our recent safety incidents and trends across all our manufacturing sites. Can you get me both of those datasets so we can address cost optimization and safety improvements in our next operations review?

steps.step_name: Show me our material expenses broken down by supplier and identify any compliance gaps in our production operations
Analyze our recent safety incidents and trends across all manufacturing sites

intent_resolver.reason: The request requires two distinct analytical datasets (supplier cost breakdown and safety incident analysis) for a strategic review, not a single end-to-end operational process; this is an ad-hoc cross-functional reporting need rather than a registered skill's workflow.

sub_queries: Pull material expenses broken down by supplier to support cost optimization analysis
Identify and report on compliance gaps across our production operations
Analyze recent safety incidents and trends across all manufacturing sites
